node.statement: Let C=conv W, a_j=P_vj, a_j^+=max(a_j,0), a_j^-=max(-a_j,0), and nu_v=sum_j a_j^-. The exact signed idempotent identities imply p_v=sum_j a_j p_j and sum_j a_j=1; with S=sum_j a_j^+=1+nu_v, the point q=S^{-1} sum_j a_j^+ p_j is a convex combination of rows and p_v=q+sum_j a_j^-(q-p_j).
